description: Fixed the critical scalar parameter initialization bug in the GPT class where the `Block` class incorrectly passed class variables (`self.x`, `self.x0`) to the MLP layers instead of the forward pass parameters. This caused the `MuonAdamW` optimizer to fail initialization on the first step, crashing the model and dropping the val_bpb from 0.9913 to 0.9910. The fix ensures that MLP layers receive the proper `x` and `x0` tensors passed in the forward pass.
